blogs.title: Why Angles Matter: The Secret Geometry Behind Better AI Art
blogs.description: Explore the fascinating core concept of the research: why the 'angles' between neurons in an AI model hold the secret to its meaning. This post explains how Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) works by rotating the model's internal weights without destroying the knowledge it learned during pre-training.

blogs.title: Better than LoRA? How Orthogonal Finetuning is Revolutionizing Model Customization
blogs.description: A deep dive into the practical benefits of OFT compared to popular methods like LoRA and ControlNet. We break down why OFT offers faster convergence, better stability, and—most importantly—zero extra computational cost during the image generation phase.

blogs.title: Mastering Precision: From Sketches to Subjects with OFT
blogs.description: Focusing on the two main applications of the paper, this blog post demonstrates how OFT enables users to create highly accurate 'digital twins' (subject-driven generation) and turn simple sketches or maps into complex artworks (controllable generation) with unprecedented fidelity.

blogs.title: The Fourier Transform of AI: Preserving the 'Soul' of Diffusion Models
blogs.description: Using the paper's analogy of the Fourier Transform, this post explains how we can separate the 'magnitude' of a neural network from its 'phase.' Learn how preserving the hyperspherical energy allows us to change what an AI generates while keeping its original creative 'soul' intact.
